subject: Marketplace onboarding grant allocation for SI-led pilot
messages:
From: Priya Suresh <priya@bluepeak.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: AWS Marketplace onboarding credits for SI-led pilot

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the quick chat this morning. BluePeak is ready to kick off a 12-week SI-led pilot with three of our customers (two mid-market, one enterprise). To make the go-to-market motion smooth on AWS Marketplace and to cover initial usage during the proof-of-value, we're requesting $12k in promotional credits that we can apply to marketplace test accounts (split across the three pilots).

Scope highlights are attached (BluePeak_Pilot_SOW.pdf) — high-level: integration support, co-branded kickoff, and a joint case study if outcomes look good. We have a reseller listing in AWS Marketplace already but need Redwood credits to ensure no friction for our trial customers while they evaluate latency/cost tradeoffs.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can issue partner-sourced marketplace credits for SI pilots, and what the approval path/timeframe looks like? Also happy to sign a short grant agreement if required.

Appreciate it —
Priya
Priya Suresh
Head of Partnerships, BluePeak Systems
priya@bluepeak.com | +1 (415) 555-0147
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Suresh <priya@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-09T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: AWS Marketplace onboarding credits for SI-led pilot

Hi Priya —

Thanks — that SOW is helpful. Short answer: yes, we have a partner-sourced promo credit workflow for marketplace/onboarding pilots, but approvals depend on GL budget and a quick legal grant agreement.

Laura (cc) handles partner credit approvals for marketplace programs. Karthik — can you confirm the standard allocation range you typically approve for SI pilots and the finance step? We'll need:
- confirmation of the split ($/customer)
- expected start date for each pilot customer
- a signed marketplace grant agreement (we can route via DocuSign)

Priya, if you can share the customer names and expected AWS account IDs (or marketplace test account emails) we'll draft the grant and route for signature. I'll kick this to Laura for approval once we have those details.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
From: Priya Suresh <priya@bluepeak.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-10T08:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: AWS Marketplace onboarding credits for SI-led pilot

Jordan / Laura —

Thanks for the quick reply. Details below: 
- Total requested: $12,000 promotional credit applied across 3 pilot accounts (alloc: $5k / $4k / $3k).
- Start windows: Customer A (Aug 23), Customer B (Aug 30), Customer C (Sep 7).
- AWS Marketplace test emails (for credit redemption): pilot-a@bluepeak-pilot.onmicrosoft.com, pilot-b@bluepeak-pilot.onmicrosoft.com, pilot-c@bluepeak-pilot.onmicrosoft.com.

Attached again: BluePeak_Pilot_SOW.pdf (outline + anticipated metrics). We're happy to sign Redwood's standard grant agreement. If it helps speed approvals I can also propose a short mutual MOU that limits credits to marketplace usage only and includes the case study cooperation clause.

Let me know if finance/legal need anything else.

Best,
Priya
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Suresh <priya@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Finance Team <finance@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-13T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: AWS Marketplace onboarding credits for SI-led pilot

Priya / Jordan,

Appreciate the clear scope and timeline. Approved: Redwood will issue a $12,000 marketplace promotional allocation for the three pilots as requested (split per your allocation). Conditions: 
- Credits are valid for AWS Marketplace usage only and must be redeemed by the provided test account emails.
- Credits expire 90 days after issuance; each pilot should start within the windows provided.
- BluePeak will sign the Redwood Marketplace Grant Agreement (attached: marketplace_grant_agreement.pdf).

Finance — please create promo code GRANT-D-78923 and allocate $12,000 to AWS Marketplace batch. Karthik — coordinate the DocuSign flow; we need executed grant back by Aug 18 to meet the first pilot start on Aug 23.

Priya — once executed, we'll confirm code delivery and a short onboarding call with our partner ops team. Looking forward to the case study.

Laura Bennett
VP, Channels & Partnerships, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0199
